idea: A long sheet of paper scrolls up for three minutes while its rows of marks change kind every half minute, from dots to stars, as a pen crosses the top from one edge to the other.
leave: A long, steady scroll can still keep changing under your eyes.
subject: the kind of mark in the rows

device.what: a line along the top that a pen draws from left to right over the whole film
device.why: it shows how far along the scroll is, so each new kind of mark lands at a place the viewer can see

change.from: rows of ink dots, some red, a ruler at the left and the pen at the top left corner
change.to: dots in the upper half, rows of rings rising into the lower half, the pen a sixth of the way along the top
rings above, hatched strokes rising below, the pen a third of the way along

change.from: rings above, hatched strokes rising below
change.to: hatching above, wavy lines rising below, the pen at the middle of the top line

change.from: the pen at the middle, straight hatching above and the first wavy lines below
change.to: waves above, solid squares rising below, the pen two thirds of the way along

change.from: waves above, solid squares rising below
change.to: squares above, stars rising below, the pen five sixths of the way along
a page of stars and the line along the top drawn all the way to the right
